cases.rationale: Burning under the breastbone that starts 60-90 minutes after a large fried supper, eases with sitting up and an antacid, and never accompanies walking, is a documented reflux pattern. Watch HR stays flat at 68-72 and RR 14-15, so no vital moves and the chest-pain trigger does not fire. The right response is a nurse call on diet, timing of meals and the omeprazole review. Naive-model trap: a shallow model reads 'chest burning' and pages urgently, when the timing with the meal, the relief with an antacid and the flat heart rate describe reflux rather than cardiac pain.
cases.decisive_feature: Burning that starts 60-90 minutes after a fried supper and eases with an antacid, with no walking link and watch HR flat at 68-72 bpm.
